thread.title: Bulls take bite out of Apple calls

author: InvestorsObserver
title: Bulls take bite out of Apple calls
text:
Shutterstock photo Traders are taking Tuesday bullish position on Apple ( AAPL ). So far, 3,134 contracts of the Oct. 215 call have changed hands, against open interest of 924 contracts. Pricing has been in the high half of the bid-ask spread, indicating that these calls about being opened from the buy side. InvestorsKeyhole Trade Alert IK-> The technicals for AAPL ($185.21 down $2.78) are bullish with a downward trend. The stock has support around 181. Look at the Aug. 155/160 bull-put spread for a 25-cent credit. That's a 5.3% return and the stock has to fall by 13.6% to cause a problem. [InvestorsKeyhole, various news and data services]
